_comment: Kraken is linked as ONE program. tools/pack_kraken.py compiles these sources, links them once to see what each file keeps,
packs every file into the free flash and SRAM of the build (docs/flash-allocation.md) and writes the builder's blobs and claims.
tools/gen_manifest.py copies this file, with each source's full cflags, into kraken_ui.patch.json's "pack".
sources: link order. {"file", "opt" (replaces defaults.opt), "cflags" (added), "keep": true (every .text section is kept)}.
keep: input-section patterns kept in every file (gc roots beyond the manifest's @kraken: references and the entry).
not_linked: {file: why} for a source of this folder that the release link leaves out (tools/pack_kraken.py lint wants one or the other).
sram_groups: state that must sit together or at a fixed place. Each takes input sections of files ({file, sections}; default the
file's whole .bss), placed contiguously in the order given; claim + offset (or offset_from_end) pins the group inside a claim;
max bounds its size; symbols = [start, end] defined around it. Every other file's .bss is packed on its own.
sram_unions: {name, why, take: [{file, sections}]}. Like a group, but every taken piece sits at ONE base and the union is as big
as the largest piece: state used only while its own screen is open (krk.h KRK_SCREEN_BSS = section .bss.scr; rule in
docs/flash-allocation.md). List every file that uses KRK_SCREEN_BSS; an unlisted file's .bss.scr is packed as ordinary .bss.

sram_groups.name: big
sram_groups.why: F9 Parrot / F13 Burst Voice shared buffer, one owner at a time (krk_vframe.c big_buf); the claim is pinned because the mi_rng measurement build taps it

sram_groups.name: bvt
sram_groups.why: F13 framing, AMBE and screen state live in the last 0x200 bytes of the shared buffer (krk_bvscr.c checks the place and zeroes it at screen entry)

sram_groups.name: bvm
sram_groups.why: F13 modem state, zeroed as one range at screen entry (krk_bvscr.c)

sram_unions.name: scr
sram_unions.why: Working state of live screens (RSSI, Band Scope, Grid, Last Heard view, DMR Link, Satellites): only one screen runs at a time (krk_run_screen) and each enter() initialises its own, so they share one SRAM region
